UN adopts map that accurately shows Africa's size

The United Nations approved a new world map that more accurately reflects the relative sizes of continents. The map displays Africa as larger than it appears on many conventional maps and the United States as smaller. The change aims to correct distortions caused by the Mercator projection commonly used in textbooks and media. The adoption was reported by Al Jazeera English and The Japan Times. No further details on implementation were provided.
